title: Central's causal-completion recovery reaches a new remote test request only after a full sweep of all mailbox history (32 rows per tick), so remote credit takes hours
outcome: A remote run's native completion for a new causal test request is pulled and settled within a bounded time that does not grow with Central's total mailbox history.
acceptance: A causal test request's native completion, once durably available on the runner, is pulled and settled within a bounded number of recovery ticks that is independent of the number of unrelated rows in mailbox_messages and mailbox_relay_intents. A behavioural test with a large unrelated history ahead of the request row (several thousand rows) asserts settlement within that bound.

The existing guarantees are kept: per-row malformed-row skips with bounded diagnostics (the w-0742 fix), idempotent saved-completion replay, original custody and selector checks, and no unindexed full-table scan per tick.
A pending request whose completion is not yet available is retried within the same bound once it becomes available. It is never skipped until a later full sweep.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
